article.hook: When fairness feels like a contract you can’t break, you’re in Saturn’s Libra stretch. It’s the long haul of proving that respect isn’t just talk but something you build and guard over years.
article.lived: For the next couple of years, relationships and deals take on a weight you can’t ignore. It’s not about sparks or quick fixes; it’s about showing up, keeping score, and making sure what you agree to lasts beyond the moment. You’ll notice meetings where silence speaks louder than promises, and partnerships where every step forward demands a quiet nod or a firm signature.
article.turn: The gift flips when sticking to the rules becomes a shield for coldness or fear - turning fairness into a cage. You can’t build a durable bond by hiding behind the letter of the law and skipping the messy truth of feelings. Commit only if you’re ready to keep the deal honest inside and out.
moves: Write down one agreement you’ve let slip without follow-up and set the date to fix it.
Host a discussion where the goal is to clarify expectations, not to debate right and wrong.
Pause before saying yes - ask what sticking to this means for your energy over the next year.
